verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation including speech (Kling 2.6), pricing tiers 'with audio + voice control', and an Elements system that keeps character voice consistent across shots. Together these indicate generated characters can speak, but no evidence explicitly says lip movement is synchronized to the dialogue or that user-supplied lines or audio drive the mouth. Missing for 10: explicit lip-sync documentation, confirmation that user-provided dialogue or audio drives the lip movement, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync quality.
